# QCrypton PQC Scanner Agent — Internal Network PQ Readiness

Post-quantum cryptography posture across internal network appliances and VNet endpoints. Data source: `PQReadiness_CL`.

content.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by QuantumPosture
| render piechart
content.title: Overall quantum posture distribution

content.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResourceType has_any ('F5', 'CheckPoint', 'PaloAlto', 'Cisco', 'Fortinet')
| summarize Vulnerable = countif(QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'), Compliant = countif(QuantumPosture == 'compliant'), Partial = countif(QuantumPosture == 'partial') by ResourceType
| order by Vulnerable desc
content.title: Appliance posture by vendor

content.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| summarize Vulnerable = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), ResourceType
| render timechart
content.title: Vulnerable findings over time by resource type

content.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| summarize Latest = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AssetIdentifier
| project Resource = ResourceName, Type = ResourceType, AssetKind, Algorithm, KeySize, Reason = PostureReason, Risk = RiskScore, Expires = ExpiresOn, Subscription = SubscriptionId
| order by Risk desc
content.title: Top vulnerable assets (ordered by risk)

content.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where QuantumPosture == 'compliant'
| where Metadata contains 'pqc_hybrid_key_exchange' or Metadata contains 'f5_pqc_engine_active' or Metadata contains 'pqc_cert_ready'
| summarize Latest = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AssetIdentifier
| project Resource = ResourceName, Type = ResourceType, Algorithm, Reason = PostureReason, TimeGenerated
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: PQC-ready endpoints (quantum-safe confirmed)

content.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AssetKind == 'tls-cert' and isnotnull(ExpiresOn)
| where QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| where ResourceType has_any ('F5', 'CheckPoint', 'PaloAlto', 'Cisco', 'Fortinet')
| project ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, ResourceType, SignatureAlgorithm, ExpiresOn, RiskScore
| order by ExpiresOn asc
content.title: Appliance certificates by expiry date
